plugins.name: zcode-touchbar
plugins.description: Operate ZCode inquiries from the MacBook Touch Bar: AI questions (AskUserQuestion) become option buttons, tool permission prompts become Allow/Deny buttons.

description_i18n.en: Operate ZCode inquiries from the MacBook Touch Bar: AI questions (AskUserQuestion) become option buttons, tool permission prompts become Allow/Deny buttons.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 MacBook Touch Bar 上操作 ZCode 的询问项：AI 提问（AskUserQuestion）变成选项按钮，工具权限确认变成「允许/拒绝」按钮。
